description: Fast flags, k=1: eight distinct images (the c6525-25g variant of the burst arm) (1 GiB shared base + 64 MiB unique each) provisioned to B and launched back to back on a cold B; the working set is the first ten recorded actions of the corpus bundle named in the nodes config. The working set runs inside a chroot of the data disk (/mnt/cas) with the bundle's recorded cwd and environment.

r6615.note: SMT off (setup.sh nosmt): 32 physical cores; irq, daemon and guest sets on distinct cores, 24-31 idle

c6525-25g.note: SMT off (setup.sh nosmt): 16 physical cores; eight guest cores, so the g16 units and the 16-image burst are not in this node type's plan

loopback-8.note: development: both members on one 8-vCPU VM, as in the 2026-11-13 harness validation

working_set: dd if=/mnt/cas/data bs=4096 count=1024 iflag=direct status=none | sha256sum
dd if=/mnt/cas/data bs=4096 count=1024 skip=16384 iflag=direct status=none | sha256sum
